messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- [2025-01-17] standup/cinder/2025-01-17: The product catalog lives with the Cinder team. Cinder owns the indexer.
- [2026-05-28] standup/cinder/2026-05-28: Yuki Tanaka still has the Cinder pager.
- [2025-05-02] standup/cinder/2025-05-02-3: Cinder has moved to the third floor.
- [2026-03-17] standup/cinder/2026-03-17: Reminder: notifier is owned by team Cinder.
- [2025-06-02] standup/cinder/2025-06-02: Cinder adopted trunk-based development.
- [2025-01-08] standup/cinder/2025-01-08: For the org chart: Yuki and Diego are on team Cinder.
- [2025-05-02] standup/cinder/2025-05-02: Yuki picked up the Cinder on-call shift from Diego today.
- [2025-12-15] standup/cinder/2025-12-15: Team change: Diego leaves team Cinder and joins team Ember, effective today. With Diego moving on, Yuki is on call for the Cinder team from today.
- [2025-08-29] standup/cinder/2025-08-29: Cinder on-call swapped this morning. Diego carries the phone until the next rotation.
- [2025-06-13] standup/cinder/2025-06-13: Diego Alvarez has the Cinder pager this cycle, taking over from Yuki Tanaka.
- [2025-03-27] standup/cinder/2025-03-27: Rotation day for Cinder: Yuki hands the pager to Diego Alvarez.
- [2025-02-17] standup/cinder/2025-02-17: Reminder from the Cinder team: page Yuki Tanaka for anything this cycle, not Diego.
- [2025-01-16] standup/cinder/2025-01-16: Diego Alvarez takes the first the Cinder team on-call shift of the year.
- [2025-11-25] standup/cinder/2025-11-25: Team Cinder on-call swapped this morning. Diego carries the phone until the next rotation.
- [2025-07-22] standup/cinder/2025-07-22: Cinder on-call swapped this morning. Yuki Tanaka carries the phone until the next rotation.
- [2025-10-02] standup/cinder/2025-10-02: On-call rotation: Yuki is primary for team Cinder starting today; Diego is off rotation.
- [2025-09-26] standup/cinder/2025-09-26: The Cinder team saw that the notifier's request volume halved following the client rollout; not their service, so they flagged it.
- [2026-04-17] standup/cinder/2026-04-17: Observation from the Cinder team: after the runtime upgrade, the authentication gateway's cold start time tripled.
- [2026-05-01] standup/cinder/2026-05-01-2: Observation from the Cinder team: after the marketing send, the flags service's queue depth hit 50,000.
- [2025-12-15] standup/cinder/2025-12-15-2: Observation from the Cinder team: after the retention change, the catalog service's disk usage jumped 30 percent.
- [2025-08-29] standup/cinder/2025-08-29-2: The Cinder team noticed that search-indexer's disk usage jumped 30 percent after the retention change and pinged the owners.
- [2025-05-02] standup/cinder/2025-05-02-2: The catalog deploy window: on Mondays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC. Team Cinder holds planning on Mondays.
- [2025-07-18] handover/2025-07-18-auth-gateway-correction: Correction to the handover note of 2025-07-01: auth-gateway went to team Boreal, not the Cinder team. Cinder never owned it; the note was written against the wrong team.
- [2025-08-20] standup/cinder/2025-08-20: Decision: clients will cache feature-flags evaluations for 30 seconds, because feature-flags saw 40,000 requests per second at peak and most of them were identical. Cinder noticed that the reporting service's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy and pinged the owners.
- [2025-11-19] handover/2025-11-19-notifier: Notifier has a new home: the Cinder team. Boreal kept it until today.
- [2025-09-15] standup/cinder/2025-09-15: Reminder that the catalog service depends on image-resizer.
- [2025-03-28] standup/cinder/2025-03-28: The product catalog depends on image-resizer for thumbnails.
- [2025-01-17] standup/cinder/2025-01-17-2: The monthly cost review is run by Yuki.
- [2026-04-29] handover/2026-04-29-ledger: Cinder is taking over the ledger from team Boreal, effective today. Dashboards and alerts are being repointed.
- [2025-02-28] handover/2025-02-28-search-indexer: Quick one: the indexer belongs to the Boreal team starting today. Thanks to Cinder for running it until now.
- [2025-11-19] handover/2025-11-19-image-resizer: From today the pager for image-resizer rings the Boreal team, not Cinder. Ownership transferred.
- [2025-10-20] handover/2025-10-20-catalog: Quick one: the product catalog belongs to the Boreal team starting today. Thanks to the Cinder team for running it until now.
- [2025-07-01] handover/2025-07-01-auth-gateway: Quick one: the auth gateway belongs to team Cinder starting today. Thanks to the Ember team for running it until now.
- [2026-04-06] handover/2026-04-06-notifier: Handover: as of today the notifier moves from the Cinder team to team Boreal. Yuki walked Lena through the runbook this morning.

Question: Who is the manager of Cinder?

message.reasoning:

The memory entries mention Yuki Tanaka, Diego Alvarez as members of team Cinder. Yuki runs the monthly cost review. Yuki holds the pager. But nothing says who the manager of Cinder is.

So the answer is: I don't know
